messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected in eu-gpu-pool — autoscaler failed to scale, queue growth observed, requests throttled. Pager: @sam (oncall-sre). Please acknowledge and triage. :rotating_light:

sam (oncall-sre): ack — jumping in. seeing sustained queue growth on eu-gpu-pool since ~00:12 UTC. frontend 429s and spike in latency on /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. pulling autoscaler logs now.

maria (sre-lead): any obvious error in autoscaler? provider quota, or internal scale-limit? which customers impacted?

sam (oncall-sre): autoscaler log tail shows repeated provision failures: `provider_api: create_instance -> 403 QUOTA_EXCEEDED` then exponential backoff, then `scale_limit reached for pool eu-gpu-pool`. top queues by tenant: acme-analytics (150k jobs), betakit (32k). embedding jobs stuck earliest.

amit (infra): confirming provider quota hit in eu region (account-level spot quota). Also noticed our `scale_limit` for eu-pool set to 24 nodes — we hit 24 and autoscaler no-op. fallback flavor attempts failed because model requires >24GB memory.

jess (customer-success): starting comms: drafting status page update. ETA for initial message? We should call out degraded gen/embedding for a subset of customers. :loud_sound:

ops-bot: automated action suggestion: reroute non-VIP traffic -> us-west fallback pool. Command: `/routing apply --from eu --filter non-vip --to us-west-fallback --weight 1.0`

sam (oncall-sre): applying mitigations now: 1) trigger manual provider quota request (in parallel), 2) enable cross-region spillover rules for non-VIP routes, 3) temporarily reduce `batch_size` and enable aggressive prefix/KV caching to reduce per-token GPU pressure.

(snip) logs:
```
autoscaler: attempt=17 pool=eu-gpu-pool action=scale_up result=error err=quota_exceeded provider=cloud-x region=eu-west-2
autoscaler: scale_limit=24 current=24 desired=30
```

amit (infra): spun up emergency pool `eu-burst-1` with smaller models for non-critical workloads, and manually bumped routing. starting drain.

sam (oncall-sre): queue size peaked ~ 210k, backlog draining after reroute + cache changes. currently at ~18k and falling. responding hosts show reduced 429s. will keep monitoring for 30m.

maria (sre-lead): customer impact summary for ops notes: partial degradation for gen+embeddings for ~45m; VIP tenants had higher priority and saw best-effort failover. No PII exposed. open ticket created: INC-2791 (acme-analytics follow-up).

jess (customer-success): published status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1799999001 — sent hold message to acme-eng.

ops-bot: automation note: reroute applied OK. `/routing status --from eu` shows non-vip -> us-west-fallback active.

sam (oncall-sre): mitigation looks good. queue drain rate improved after 00:36 UTC. will prepare handoff to day oncall in 30m.

maria (sre-lead): assigning postmortem owner: @maria. initial RCA notes: 1) provider-side quota exhaustion in eu + 2) conservative `scale_limit` prevented emergency spillup 3) autoscaler backoff jitter insufficient leading to synchronized retries causing provisioning storms.

amit (infra): immediate action items (short term): - request increased eu quota with provider (high priority) - add alert for provider quota errors - add emergency override to raise `scale_limit` w/ approval - test fallback model flavors for memory footprint reductions

maria (sre-lead): long-term action items: - implement cross-region spillover (routing + data locality doc) - run synthetic surge tests on eu pools monthly - improve autoscaler retry policy (jitter + capped parallel creates) - add per-tenant queue-length-based throttling to protect VIPs

sam (oncall-sre): documenting timeline and commands in the incident runbook. will attach logs and metrics to postmortem.

incident-bot: Severity updated to SEV2 -> RESOLVED. Mitigations in place, queue draining under threshold. Incident window ~00:12 UTC - 00:57 UTC. Duration ~45m.

jess (customer-success): followups: CS to coordinate teardown email for affected customers, offer credits where appropriate, and schedule a sync with acme-analytics tomorrow.

maria (sre-lead): postmortem draft link: https://redwood.internal/pm/1799999001-draft — will assign owners and review at Blameless tomorrow 10:00am.

sam (oncall-sre): handing off to @maria for remediation work. leaving notes in ticket. good recovery everyone. :thumbsup:

maria (sre-lead): taking postmortem ownership. will follow up with a prioritized action list and ETA estimates by EOD.
